description:
crate-jmap-types/ has README.md, PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md,
LICENSE, Cargo.toml — and no CHANGELOG.md or RELEASES.md.

jmap-types is published to crates.io at 0.1.1. The 13 commits in this
review epic added eight `pub extra` fields, migrated 10 sites to the
`State` newtype, surfaced a new `updated_properties` field on the base
`ChangesResponse`, and several other public-surface changes. None of
this is communicated to a crates.io consumer pinning to `^0.1`.

What a caller depending on this API in production accepts:

1. Between 0.1.1 and a future 0.1.2 (or 0.2.0), there is no published
   record of what changed. The only audit trail is `git log` on the
   monorepo, which the crates.io consumer does not have a path to
   without manually finding the repository.
2. Beads (bd) issues are the project's internal task tracker. They
   document the *why*. They are not what an external caller reads to
   know \"did 0.1.2 break me?\".
3. Even within this workspace, the propagation rule on canonical
   crates ('change here ripples through 30 sibling crates') depends
   on contributors knowing what changed. CHANGELOG.md is the natural
   index for that propagation.

JMAP-6xs8.3 (\"Cargo.toml version not bumped despite breaking changes\")
covers the SemVer half. This finding covers the docs half: even if the
version is bumped correctly, there is currently no human-readable
artifact accompanying the bump.

Fix candidates:
- Add `CHANGELOG.md` following Keep-a-Changelog format. Start with
  an `[Unreleased]` section that captures the 13 commits' worth of
  changes (the bd epic JMAP-6xs8 children make a strong skeleton).
- Inherit the workspace AGENTS.md convention if there is one for
  changelogs (currently there isn't; this finding may prompt one).
- Mirror the workspace README convention's six-section shape into a
  changelog convention so all sibling crates follow the same pattern.

This finding applies to every workspace crate that ships to crates.io,
not just `jmap-types`. Filed here because this review's scope is
`crate-jmap-types since 9c0d34f`; flag for the workspace-API
supplement to propagate.
title: No CHANGELOG.md for published jmap-types 0.1.1 crate
